title: Stacky Heights, Entropy, and Zeta Functions of Weighted Hypersurfaces over Finite Fields
summary: Let \(X\subset \mathbb P^n_{\mathbf w}\) be a weighted hypersurface over \(\mathbb F_q\), with associated stack \(\mathfrak X\). For \(\mathbf x\in X(\mathbb F_{q^r})\), let \(g_{\mathbf x}(r)=\gcd(k_{S(\mathbf x)},q^r-1)\), where \(k_S=\gcd(w_i:i\in S)\), and define \(Θ_r(s)=\sum_{\mathbf x}g_{\mathbf x}(r)^{1-s}\) and \(Z_H^{\mathrm{can}}(\mathfrak X,s;t)=\exp(\sum_{r\ge1}Θ_r(s)t^r/r)\).
